curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: open with what regulatory signs state and the red slash circle, then speed limits, the ideal-conditions rule and the minimum floor, then lane control and no-passing signs
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: one-fact cards on the red slash circle, speed maximum and minimum, lane control arrows and no-passing zones plus the two contrasts
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: module quiz on what regulatory signs demand and how to treat posted maximum and minimum speeds

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: teach the stop sign procedure and the yield sign, then one-way and divided-highway signs, then do-not-enter and wrong-way, and finish with the blue rail emergency sign
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: one-fact cards per sign with contrast cards for stop versus yield, one-way versus divided and do-not-enter versus wrong-way
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: module quiz on what each regulatory sign orders and how the paired signs differ

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: introduce the yellow diamond warning family, then crossroad, signal-ahead, merging and two-way signs, then the divided-highway pair, the T-intersection and the lane-ends sign
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: one-fact cards per warning sign with contrast cards for crossroad versus T, signal versus merge and divided begins versus ends
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: module quiz on what each intersection and road-layout warning sign means

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: teach the curve sign and chevrons, the slippery-when-wet and hill signs, the ramp-speed sign, then the deer, horse-drawn and farm-machinery crossing signs
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: one-fact cards per sign with contrast cards for curve versus chevrons and buggies versus farm machinery
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: module quiz on what each curve, hill, ramp and animal or slow-mover sign asks you to do

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: teach the pedestrian-crossing sign and who it covers, then the school-bus-stop-ahead and advance-school-crossing signs and how they differ
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: one-fact cards on the pedestrian, bus-stop and school-crossing signs plus the bus-versus-crossing contrast
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: module quiz on who to watch for at pedestrian and school warnings
